run_convert_videos: run the script to convert MP4 videos to AVI format using ffmpeg with parallel processing
run_exe_cmd: run a shell command and return output or skip if the destination file already exists
run_convert_video_wapper: run batch video conversion on a list of videos using an ffmpeg command format string
run_read_video_list: run a scan of subdirectories to collect all MP4 video file paths from a root folder
run_main: run the main block to convert Kinetics dataset videos from source to destination with optional shuffling
